name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2026-06-22, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
